texts.bbe: I give orders in the name of the Lord that all the brothers are to be present at the reading of this letter.
texts.message: And make sure this letter gets read to all the brothers and sisters. Don't leave anyone out.
texts.nkjv: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read to all the holy brethren.
